headline: Infineon keynote describes generative-AI real-number-model creation within an AI-based verification methodology
fact: A SMACD 2026 keynote by an Infineon principal engineer describes industrial experience connecting AI assistants, retrieval-augmented knowledge systems, and EDA tools through APIs, along with a current focus on an AI-based verification methodology. Its concrete example generates SystemVerilog real-number models from schematics, specifications, or other source models while emphasizing domain knowledge, guardrails, compliance, and human review. This Event records the scope described by the keynote, not a measured deployment result.

sources.title: AI Transformation in IC Development: An Industrial Perspective on Reshaping Verification Methodology in the Generative-AI Era
